content.text: Submitted. The sole change this pass was to restate limb (b) so the return duty leads and the deadline follows it directly — "return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after such expiry or termination" — making the 30-day post-termination return express on the face of the obligation. All other preferred terms (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, deletion and written certification thereafter) are unchanged, and Sections 10.1, 10.2 and 16.5 are untouched.
